target.title: refactor(plugin-sdk): prune eligible deprecated exports
target.body:
Closes #105980

AI-assisted: yes. The complete diff and compatibility boundaries were manually audited; fresh Codex autoreview is clean.

## What Problem This Solves

The public plugin SDK surface gate carried removable, unshipped compatibility exports while bundled code still used deprecated entrypoints and the legacy raw channel send result shape. That kept exact export budgets higher than necessary and encouraged new callers to copy compatibility-only APIs.

## Why This Change Was Made

This change audits consumers and tag history before removal, preserves shipped compatibility entrypoints through their documented major-version window, removes four eligible entrypoint-qualified exports, and migrates bundled Telegram and Zalo callers to canonical SDK contracts. Zalo now returns typed delivery results with receipts and throws failed raw sends at the adapter boundary; `ChannelSendRawResult` remains available but is deprecated until the next plugin-SDK major.

## User Impact

Plugin authors get a smaller, better-guarded public surface without breaking shipped compatibility paths. Bundled Zalo delivery now follows the canonical `OutboundDeliveryResult` contract while preserving message receipts and explicit send failures.

## Evidence

- Surface ratchet: public exports 10,639 -> 10,635; callable exports 5,355 -> 5,351; deprecated exports 3,284 -> 3,281. Deprecated public subpaths remain 53 and deprecated barrels remain 13.
- `pnpm plugin-sdk:surface:check` and `pnpm plugin-sdk:api:check` pass on Testbox `tbx_01kxcv06azkt4tgjsnabfrt2j9`.
- 72 focused tests pass across six Vitest shards: pairing store, approval reactions, channel pairing, channel send results, SDK package subpaths, Telegram, and Zalo.
- `pnpm build` passes, including the public plugin SDK declaration graph and Control UI build, on Testbox `tbx_01kxcsvgfa9wkdkgk97sjn7zes`.
- Core, production-extension, scripts, and core-test TypeScript lanes pass. Targeted oxfmt, oxlint, pairing-scope guard, and repository docs lint pass.
- `pnpm check:changed` clears all ratchets, API/export/surface guards, formatting, dependency guards, and core/production-extension typechecks. Known gap: extension-test typecheck currently fails in untouched `extensions/qa-lab/src/suite.test.ts` because its mock lacks `artifactPointerPath` and `generation`; PR CI remains authoritative.
- Testbox Actions proof: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29223495723
- Fresh autoreview: clean, no actionable findings, correctness confidence 0.88.
